text: Maafisa wa serikali ya Yemen wamesema kuwa tangu Alhamisi , Wahuthi walifanya mashambulizi ya nguvu kutoka upande wa kaskazini , kusini na magharibi , lakini hawakufanikiwa kuingia katika ngome za ulinzi za serikali ambazo ziliimarishwa na mashambulizi ya angani yaliofanywa na ushirika wa kijeshi unaongozwa na Saudi Arabia .
trans_text: Yemeni government officials say that since Thursday, the Houthis have launched heavy attacks from the north, south and west, but have failed to penetrate government strongholds that were reinforced by airstrikes by the Saudi-led coalition.

text: Kudhibiti jimbo lenye utajiri wa mafuta la Marib kutawapa nguvu Wahuthi kuweza kuwa na nafasi ya kufanya mazungumzo ya amani , lakini vita vimeongeza hofu ya kuongezeka kwa janga la kibinadamu , wakati wananchi wengi wa Yemen wakikimbia kutoka jimbo hilo wakiepuka mapigano katika maeneo mengine na nchi hiyo .
trans_text: The capture of the oil-rich Marib province will give the Houthis a chance to negotiate a peace deal, but the fighting has raised fears of a growing humanitarian crisis as many Yemenis flee the province to avoid fighting elsewhere in the country.

text: Vita vya Yemen vimeanza mwaka 2014 wakati Wahuthi walipouteka mji mkuu Sanaa , na kuibua Muungano wa kijeshi unaongozwa na Saudi Arabia kuingilia kati kuisaidia serikali mwaka uliofuatia .
trans_text: Yemen's war began in 2014 when the Houthis captured the capital, Sana'a, prompting a Saudi-led coalition to intervene to help the government the following year.

text: Wakati Umoja wa Mataifa na Washington zikishinikiza kumalizika kwa vita hivyo , Wahuthi wanadai kufunguliwa uwanja wa ndege wa Sanaa , uliofungwa chini ya kizuizi cha Saudi Arabia tangu mwaka 2016 , kabla ya kusitishwa mapigano yoyote au mazungumzo .
trans_text: As the United Nations and Washington push for an end to the fighting, the Houthis are demanding the reopening of Sana'a airport, which has been closed under a Saudi blockade since 2016, before any fighting stops or talks begin.

text: Pamoja na mapigano ya umwagaji damu huko Marib , Wahuthi pia wameanza kutumia ndege zisizokuwa na rubani aina ya droni kushambulia na makombora katika maeneo ya Saudi Arabia , ikiwemo viwanda vya mafuta .
trans_text: In addition to the bloody fighting in Marib, the Houthis have also begun using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to launch missiles at Saudi Arabian sites, including oil refineries.

text: Mwezi huu mjumbe maalum wa Umoja wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya Yemen anayemaliza muda wake Martin Griffiths ameliambia Baraza la Usalama kuwa juhudi zake binafsi katika kipindi cha miaka mitatu kumaliza vita """" hazikufanikiwa . """"
trans_text: This month, the outgoing U.N. special envoy for Yemen, Martin Griffiths, told the Security Council that his own efforts over the past three years to end the war have been "unsuccessful."

text: Vita hivyo vimeua maelfu ya watu na kuwafanya asilimia 80 ya wananchi wa Yemen kutegemea misaada katika kile UN imekiita ni mgogoro mkubwa kuliko yote wa kibinadamu .
trans_text: The war has killed thousands of people and left 80 percent of Yemen's population dependent on aid in what the United Nations has called the world's worst humanitarian crisis.

text: Chanzo cha HabariFacebook imesema kwamba akaunti hizo zina lengo la kueneza habari za uongo wakati nchi hiyo inajitayarisha kwa uchaguzi mkuu alhamisi wiki hii .
trans_text: Facebook said the accounts were aimed at spreading "fake news" as the country prepares for a general election this week.

text: Katika taarifa kwa vyombo vya habari , mkuu wa mawasiliano wa kampuni ya facebook katika kanda ya Sahara Kezia Anim , amesema kwamba akaunti hizo za facebook zilikuwa zinaeneza habari zisizo za kweli ili kubadili mawazo ya wapiga kura .
trans_text: In a statement to the media, Facebook's regional communications chief for the Sahara region, Kezia Anim, said the accounts were "spreading false information to change the minds of voters."

text: Amesema kwamba akaunti zilizofungwa zilikuwa feki , na zilikuwa zinaeneza habari za uongo hasa za kushambulia wagombea wa upinzani .
trans_text: He said the accounts were fake and were spreading false information, especially against opposition candidates.

text: Watumiaji pia walikuwa wakitumia maudhui yanayowekwa kwenye mtandao na wagombea wa upinzani kwenye ukurasa huo na kubadilisha yaonekane kama yao Pamoja na kuongeza ndani habari za uongo na kuchafua wenzao sifa .
trans_text: Users were also using content posted by opposition candidates on the site to make it look like theirs, as well as inserting fake news and slandering their colleagues.

text: Kulingana na kampuni ya facebook , watumiaji wa akanuti hizo walikuwa wanazitumia kushambulia watu wengine kwa matusi na maneno makali kwenye kurasa zao na walikuwa wanatumia internet ya wizara ya habari , mawasiliano na teknolojia ya Uganda .
trans_text: According to Facebook, users of the accounts were using them to attack others with insults and harsh words on their pages and were using the Ugandan Ministry of Information, Communications and Technology's website.

text: Vyombo vya habari Uganda zinaripoti kwamba zaidi ya akaunti 100 za facebook zimefungwa .
trans_text: Ugandan media reports that more than 100 Facebook accounts have been shut down.

text: Mkuu wa mawasiliano wa rais Yoweri Museveni , Don Wanyama , ameshutumu kampuni za facebook na Twitter akidai kwamba zinashirikiana na wanasiasa wa upinzani dhidi ya chama cha NRM .
trans_text: President Yoweri Museveni's chief communications officer, Don Wanyama, has accused Facebook and Twitter of collaborating with opposition politicians against the NDP.

text: Wanyama ameandika ujumbe wa twitter akisema kwamba akaunti zote za facebook na twitter ambazo zimefungwa zinastahili kufunguliwa , akitaka tume ya mawasiliano nchini Uganda UCC , kuhakikisha kwamba kuna usawa wa kutumia mitandao ya kidigitali nchini humo .
trans_text: Wanyama tweeted that all Facebook and Twitter accounts that have been shut down should be reopened, calling on the Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) to ensure that there is equality in the use of digital networks in the country.

text: Wanyama amenukuliwa na gazeti la Daily Monitor akisema kwamba ni aibu kubwa wa kwatu kutoka nje ya nchi kujaribu kuweka utawala wao nchini Uganda kwa kufunga akaunti za facebook na twitter za chama cha NRM .
trans_text: Wanyama was quoted by the Daily Monitor as saying it was "a great shame" for the foreign power to try to establish its rule in Uganda by shutting down the Facebook and Twitter accounts of the NRM party.

text: Amesisitiza kwamba rais Yoweri Museveni hataondolewa madarakani .
trans_text: He has insisted that President Yoweri Museveni will not be removed from power.

text: Mmoja wa wasimamizi wa habari wa chama cha NRM Ashburg Kato , ameshutumu mgombea wa urais Bobi Wine kwa kushiriki katika kufunga akaunti za chama kinachotawala cha NRM .
trans_text: NRM's Ashburton Kato has accused presidential candidate Bob Wainwright of being involved in the closure of accounts of the ruling party.

text: Msemaji wa chama cha National unity platform NUP , chake Bobi Wine , Joel Senyonyi amekanusha madai kwamba wamehusika katika hatua ya kufungwa kwa akaunti hizo .
trans_text: The spokesman for the National Unity Platform (NUP), led by Bobi Wine, Joel Sennyonyi, denied any involvement in the shutdown.

text: Hatua ya facebook , inajiri siku chache baada ya serikali ya rais Yoweri Museveni , kupitia tume ya mawasiliano UCC , ikitaka kampuni ya google kufunga channeli zote za You tube za wagombea wa upinzani hasa Bobi Wine .
trans_text: Facebook's move comes days after President Yoweri Museveni's government, through the U.N. Communications Commission, called on Google to shut down all YouTube channels belonging to opposition candidate Bob Wainwright.

text: Google ilikataa kutekeleza ombi hilo .
trans_text: Google refused to comply with the request.

text: Imetayarishwa na Kennes Bwire , VOA , Washington DCWatu 16 wameuwawa katika shambulizi la Jumapili linalosadikiwa kufanywa na kundi la Al - Shabab kwenye hoteli moja mjini Mogadishu , msemaji wa serikali Ismail Mukthar Omar amesema .
trans_text: KABUL - Sixteen people were killed in an attack Sunday believed to have been carried out by al-Shabab on a hotel in Mogadishu, government spokesman Ismail Muktar Omar said.

text: Raia 11 na washambuliaji wa 5 ndio waliouawa katika shambulizi hilo , Omar aliandika kwenye twitter .
trans_text: Eleven civilians and five attackers were killed in the attack, Omar wrote on Twitter.

text: Omar ameongeza kuwa mwajeshi moja wa serekali aliuwawa , na watu 18 walijeruhiwa .
trans_text: Omar added that one government soldier was killed and 18 others were wounded.

text: Taarifa zinasema wanamgambo wa Al Shabab walivamia hoteli ya kifafari iliyopo katika ufukwe wa Lido , walitegua bomu la kwenye gari na baadae wakafyatua risasi wakitumia bunduki za rashasha .
trans_text: Al-Shabab militants stormed a luxury hotel in the coastal city of Lido, detonated a car bomb and then opened fire with machine guns.

text: Hotel hiyo inamilikiwa na Abdullahi Mohamed Nor , mbunge na waziri wa zamani wa fedha , na ilikua inatembelewa sana na maafisa wa serekali na wasomali waishio nje ya nchi .
trans_text: The hotel is owned by Abdullahi Mohamed Noor, a former parliamentarian and finance minister, and has become a popular destination for government officials and Somalis living abroad.

text: Gazeti la Los Angeles Times liliripoti kwamba Woods alikuwa akiendesha kwa mwendo kasi na alipoteza udhibiti wa gari , alivuka njia panda na kisha gari likapinduka mara kadhaa hadi lilipojikita kwenye shimo Mcheza Gofu wa kulipwa Marekani , Tiger Woods , amepata ajali mbaya ya gari Jumanne kulingana na idara ya polisi ya kaunti ya Los Angeles nchini Marekani .
trans_text: The Los Angeles Times reported that Woods was speeding and lost control of his car, slid into a ditch and then flipped over several times before crashing into a ditch.U.S. professional golfer Tiger Woods was in a serious car accident Tuesday, according to the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department.

text: Gari la Woods limeripotiwa kupinduka mara kadhaa karibu na mji wa Ranchos Palos Verdes kwenye jimbo la California ambapo Woods alitolewa kutoka kwenye gari iliyoharibika vibaya .
trans_text: Woods' car was reported to have flipped several times near the town of Ranchos Palos Verdes in California, where Woods was pulled from the badly damaged vehicle.

text: Picha za video katika eneo la ajali zinaonesha gari katika upande aliokuwa Woods limetumbukia kwenye shimo huku likiwa limeharibika vibaya .
trans_text: Video footage from the scene shows the car on Woods' side of the road slamming into the ditch, badly damaged.

text: Vipande vya gari vilionekana karibu na mabaki ya mahala gari lilipotumbukia .
trans_text: Car wreckage was found near the wreckage of the car.

text: Woods alipelekwa katika kituo cha matibabu cha UCLA , mahala ambapo anapatiwa matibabu kwa majeraha , na imeripotiwa kuwa alikuwa peke yake ndani ya gari hilo .
trans_text: Woods was taken to UCLA Medical Center, where he is being treated for injuries, and was reportedly alone in the car.

text: Ofisi ya sheriff wa kaunti ya LA imesema majeraha ya Woods hayakuwa katika kiwango cha kutishia maisha .
trans_text: The LA County Sheriff's Office said Woods' injuries were not life-threatening.

text: Gazeti la Los Angeles Times , liliripoti kwamba Woods alikuwa akiendesha kwa mwendo kasi na alipoteza udhibiti wa gari , alivuka njia panda ambayo inagawanya maeneo na kisha gari lake likapinduka mara kadhaa kabla ya kujikuta kwenye shimo .
trans_text: The Los Angeles Times reported that Woods was speeding and lost control of his car, slid across a curb and then flipped over several times before crashing into a ditch.

trans_text: The U.N. Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights is calling on Uganda to revise its ban on same-sex relationships, which it says violates human rights standards and undermines public health.

text: Mswaada uliopitishwa na Bunge la Uganda wiki iliyopita , lakini bado haujakamilishwa umekuwa ukiandaliwa tangu mwaka 2015 na kupitia mabadiliko kadhaa muhimu .
trans_text: The bill, which was passed by the Ugandan parliament last week but has not yet been finalized, has been in the works since 2015 and has undergone several major changes.

text: Maafisa wa haki za binadamu wanasema wanasikitishwa sana na uandikishaji na hatua hii ya hivi karibuni , ambayo italifanya kundi hili la watu kuwa wahalifu .
trans_text: Human rights officials say they are deeply saddened by the recent registration and deportation, which would make the group a criminal.

text: Chini ya mswaada huo , wanaona uhusiano wa jinsia moja ungeadhibiwa vikali , kama vile wafanyabiashara ya ngono na wale walioambukizwa VVU .
trans_text: Under the bill, they see same-sex relationships as punishable by the law, as well as sex workers and those infected with HIV.

text: Msemaji wa kamishna mkuu wa Umoja wa Mataifa , Rupert Colville , anasema adhabu ya mswaada huo kwa mahusiano ya jinsia moja umepunguzwa hadi miaka 10 jela badala ya kifungo cha maisha .
trans_text: U.N. spokesman Rupert Colville says the penalty for homosexuality has been reduced to 10 years in prison instead of life.

text: Walakini , anasema Sheria ya Makosa ya Kijinsia inaibua wasiwasi .
trans_text: He said the Sexual Offences Act raises concerns.

text: Colville amesema vifungu vingine vya kutisha katika Sheria hiyo ni pamoja na upimaji wa lazima na wa kulazimishwa wa VVU kwa washtakiwa .
trans_text: Colville said other threatening provisions in the law include mandatory and mandatory HIV testing for the accused.
